EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ 53rd Pay Period (weekly)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time & Attendance Support. We cannot add a 53rd pay period to the schedule, as the system is designed to recognize the number of weeks within a year rather than the exact number of days within a year. Since a year only has 52 weeks, we are unable to add a 53rd pay period to a certain year. Since the number of days within a year exceeds that calculation (52 pay periods x 7 days per pay period = 364 days), we expect there to be some crossover from year-to-year when generating pay periods. Please rest assured that the pay period schedule in the time & attendance system serves only as a guideline and does not impact your annual payroll numbers or reporting capabilities.
I’ve included instructions here for how you can generate your next year’s pay periods:
Select Company Setup > Pay Periods.
Select the appropriate schedule from the SELECT PAY PERIOD drop-down menu
Select the Generate Dates button.
Choose the year from the drop-down menu.
Time and Attendance will automatically fill in the Initial Date field to align with the day after your last pay period of the previous year.
Select the Generate Dates button to see a preview of the new year’s dates.
Verify the Start Date, Stop Date and Pay Date for the pay period listed are correct.
When all dates are accurate, select the Save Dates button.
When generating your pay periods, you will just want to ensure that there are no gaps or overlap in dates from year-to-year. For example, if the schedule for your current year ends on 12/23, you would want the following year’s pay periods to begin as of 12/24.
If you have additional questions or concerns, please let us know and we will be happy to help.
Thank you,
